title: MOT-UGC-YAPPER-01 — Updated script v5
summary: Updated supplied script, verbatim: 987 words across 48 editorial beats. Estimated 05:01.5 at 205 wpm including pauses and a 3-second end hold; timing is provisional until final narration. One consistent car presenter, separate static overlays and unique candid B-roll. The product appears visually at “So I found the same one”; no extra narration is added.

beats.script: I was two months into a GLP-1, dropping weight, and still waking up every morning feeling backed up and uncomfortable like nothing had moved.
beats.visual: Same car presenter, close eye-level frame; direct eye contact.
beats.emotion: Recognition — identify the weight-loss/discomfort contradiction.
beats.note: Open immediately on I was; no title pre-roll. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: Let me tell you what I finally found out. Because nobody told me about it either.
beats.visual: Hold the same presenter and let the invitation breathe.
beats.emotion: Curiosity — promise the missing explanation.
beats.note: Continue performance through Because nobody told me; no forced cut. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: Because I was dropping weight. The shot was actually working.
beats.visual: Small acknowledging nod; no scale numbers or weight-loss montage.
beats.emotion: Credibility — acknowledge the shot was working.
beats.note: Keep voice conversational on actually working. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: But I felt like someone had filled my gut with concrete and forgotten about it. That heavy backed-up pressure that just sat there all day.
beats.visual: Presenter describes the heaviness with understated discomfort.
beats.emotion: Agitation — make the persistent feeling recognizable.
beats.note: Stay on face for concrete; no literal concrete inside anatomy. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: I'd eat a few bites at dinner and feel like I'd swallowed a brick. And it didn't matter how little I ate. It just kept building.
beats.visual: Table-level candid view: fork set down beside a meal with only a few bites taken; body turns away.
beats.emotion: Agitation — show why even a small dinner feels difficult.
beats.note: Cut on a few bites at dinner for 3s; return on And it did not matter, following actual wording. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: My jeans were getting looser but I was still leaving the dinner table early because of how uncomfortable I felt.
beats.visual: Waist-level detail: mature hand lightly checks extra room at denim waistband; tee stays over abdomen.
beats.emotion: Contradiction — clothes improve while comfort does not.
beats.note: Cut on My jeans for 2s; return for leaving the dinner table early. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: I'd stand in the kitchen after meals just waiting for it to pass.
beats.visual: Side/rear kitchen wide: same woman rests both hands on counter and waits, gaze toward window.
beats.emotion: Isolation — make waiting after meals tangible.
beats.note: Straight cut on stand in the kitchen; hold about 3s, then back. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: And I couldn't explain it to anyone without sounding like I was being dramatic.
beats.visual: Same presenter admits she could not explain it.
beats.emotion: Empathy — vulnerability belongs on her face.
beats.note: Return before And I could not explain it, aligned to exact words. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.emotion: Open loop — weight loss was the wrong expectation.
beats.note: Continuous face coverage; no numerical scale shot. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.note: Stay on My doctor; do not invent a clinician scene. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.emotion: Persistence — the problem starts before breakfast.

beats.emotion: Open loop — acknowledge experience without a fake comparison graphic.
beats.note: Hold face through Something was definitely still missing. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: So I started doing a crazy amount of research on what was actually happening. I must have read thirty different articles. Forums, medical breakdowns, all of it.
beats.visual: Overhead evening desk: laptop with indistinct article layout, handwritten notes, mug and reading glasses; mature hand on trackpad.
beats.emotion: Search — show effort without inventing an authoritative quotation.
beats.note: Insert on thirty different articles for 3s; continuous narration. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: And then I came across a gastroenterologist who had written out exactly what GLP-1 medications do to the gut.
beats.visual: Presenter introduces what she read.
beats.emotion: Discovery — bridge from search to explanation.
beats.note: Return before gastroenterologist; no fake doctor portrait or credentials. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: He explained it like this.
beats.visual: Small natural reset before the explanation.
beats.emotion: Orientation — invite the viewer into a simple explanation.
beats.note: Brief hold on He explained it like this. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: Your stomach is basically a muscle. It contracts, churns your food, and pushes everything forward. But GLP-1 medications slow those contractions down.
beats.visual: Single educational stomach cutaway; later motion is gentle wall contraction/churning, not a blocked valve.
beats.emotion: Mechanism — establish the organ and movement once.
beats.note: Cut on stomach is basically a muscle; cover about 4s, return or hold as aligned. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: Think of a river that suddenly slows to a trickle. Everything that was flowing through starts to back up behind it.
beats.visual: Overhead shallow river view: broad upstream pool feeding a narrow gentle trickle, a few floating leaves.
beats.emotion: Understanding — translate slowed flow into the script’s metaphor.
beats.note: Straight cut on Think of a river; hold 4s. A metaphor, never a clinical before/after. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: Food backs up. Waste backs up. Gas builds with nowhere to go. And all that pressure is what you're feeling every single day.
beats.visual: Flat gut-lumen schematic: contents and several gas pockets within a soft tube; no full torso or repeated stomach.
beats.emotion: Mechanism — give gas/pressure a separate visual vocabulary.
beats.note: Cut on Food backs up for 3s; return before all that pressure lands. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: It wasn't a diet problem. It wasn't something I was doing wrong. It was the gut slowdown.
beats.visual: Return to direct eye contact; slight release on It was the gut slowdown.
beats.emotion: Relief — remove self-blame and close the first loop.
beats.note: Hard return on It was not a diet problem, using the exact spoken words. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: So now I knew what was causing it. But I still had no idea what actually addressed the slowdown itself.
beats.visual: Same presenter, curiosity rather than a sales pivot.
beats.emotion: Second loop — what addresses it?
beats.note: Hold the question through slowdown itself. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: One night I was up late scrolling through a GLP-1 support group on Facebook. And a woman posted about what she'd been taking. She said she'd been backed up for months on Ozempic until she started using three specific ingredients together.
beats.visual: Flat illustrated social-group post card, clearly labeled Illustrative recreation; no phone video.
beats.emotion: Discovery — move from research to the peer account.
beats.note: Overlay on GLP-1 support group for 4s, then return; keep mouth and captions clear. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: First was apigenin from celery juice. She said it's been shown in research to activate the receptors in the gut wall that trigger those muscle contractions. The ones that actually push food through.
beats.visual: Distinct close view of celery stalks and juice; neutral ingredient image.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 1 — give an unfamiliar name a concrete anchor; no simulated proof.
beats.note: Overlay on apigenin from celery juice for 3s; return for the receptor statement. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: Second was chlorophyllin, a plant compound that's been studied clinically to bind gas-producing compounds before they get a chance to build pressure.
beats.visual: Dark-green ingredient sample with its existing chlorophyllin label, separate from celery.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 2 — visually separate the second ingredient without an efficacy animation.
beats.note: Overlay on Second for 3s; return for clinical wording. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: Third was a soluble prebiotic fiber. But she was specific about the type because the wrong kind can actually make the gas worse, not better.
beats.visual: Small fine powder portion beside mixed water, existing category image.
beats.emotion: Ingredient 3 — make the type distinction legible.
beats.note: Overlay on soluble prebiotic fiber for 3s; face for wrong kind qualifier. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: She said it was the only thing that had actually moved the needle. She'd been on the shot for a year and said people at her gym kept asking what she was doing differently.
beats.visual: Same presenter recounts the other woman’s experience.
beats.emotion: Peer story — retain the anecdote without creating false proof.
beats.note: Stay on face; no invented gym testimonial or transformation. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: I almost kept scrolling. I'd tried the celery juice thing back in 2019 and felt absolutely nothing.
beats.visual: Skeptical recollection; slight head tilt on 2019.
beats.emotion: Objection — voice the viewer’s skepticism.
beats.note: Hold I almost kept scrolling and prior celery-juice experience. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.script: But she said it doesn't work that way on its own. You need all three together in the right ratio or you're just guessing.
beats.visual: Continue the reply in her own conversational voice.
beats.emotion: Answer — keep the stated distinction clear.
beats.note: Hold on all three together; no formula ratio numbers added. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.note: Continuous close performance through I had not felt that in months. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.note: Insert on my mornings felt different for 3s; return for the waking-up callback. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

beats.emotion: Freedom — attention returns to normal life.
beats.note: Insert on had not thought about my stomach for 3s; face for That was new. Straight cuts in/out. Continuous presenter/voice underneath. Final word alignment determines position.

notes.title: READING ORDER
notes.text: Read each UPDATED SCRIPT row left to right, then move down. All supplied narration is included exactly once in these rows. Reference frames are in their own lane.

notes.title: CURRENT SCRIPT
notes.text: 987 words; 48 thought beats, not 48 video clips. One supplied opening; old hook alternatives removed. All timing provisional.

notes.title: CAPTIONS & SOUND
notes.text: Black text on snug white boxes; 1–2 short lines. Continuous conversational voice across inserts. Keep face and captions clear. No music or SFX match is claimed.

notes.title: PRODUCT ENTRY
notes.text: The new script never says Motilli aloud. Show the exact Motilli product on So I found the same one. Preserve the script; add no spoken brand sentence.

notes.title: VISUAL VARIETY
notes.text: Every covering scene uses a distinct source and action. Dinner problem, dinner payoff and clearing plate are different compositions. Stomach, river and lumen diagram are distinct mechanism views.

notes.title: FIRST ASSET SET
notes.text: Selected GPT Image 2 presenter, candid inserts and overlays attached. Prior compatible images retained; expanded scenes generated for this revision. These are storyboard stills, not finished video.

notes.title: REFERENCE SCOPE
notes.text: Recovered Alicia Darling source and frame-level cut map retained. Transfer straight cuts, conversational presenter returns and caption style only. Reference frames are not Motilli assets or evidence.

notes.title: COPY & REPRESENTATION
notes.text: Group UI is visibly labeled illustrative recreation. No invented clinician quote, proof chart, body before/after or treatment animation. Supplied narration preserved; existing substantiation and representation dependencies remain.

notes.title: EDITOR HANDOFF
notes.text: Editing plan v5 is saved with the concept. Align cuts/captions to final voice; preserve performance speed. Future motion uses Google Omni and production editing uses DaVinci Resolve. No timeline or export created in this phase.
